column1: # French (fr) catalog. Format: see the header of ja.tsv
# (context <TAB> source <TAB> translation; @id, @plural and other contexts; escapes \n \t \\).
# Plural forms (see `plural_fr` in i18n/mod.rs): one (0 and 1) | other.

# the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
